title: Add reading-critic check for code jobs with behavior tests
summary: Retry of job 20261113-143636-4thm (dispatched, never verified, 0 findings, no candidate; redone from base). Add one reading check in athena-core after check_code_survey that refuses a code/tests reading with a behavior criterion unless it states (a) entry point, gate order and stop gate, (b) a reused existing function, (c) an accepted record kind or round-trip deliverable, (d) a direct check per property. Audience: the reader agent and maintainers judging refusals.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check refusals and acceptance by running fixtures and the replay.
cargo fmt --check, clippy and test criterion.
Rule enforced as a code check in the reading pipeline.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs (check_code_survey at line 199, changes_code_with_behavior_criterion, names_record_evidence), crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs (step!(check_code_survey(reading)) at line 539, which sets check order), crates/athena-core/src/reading/replay.rs (check_reading_text, the entry point for check-reading and replay) and crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (tests). The new check runs after check_code_survey in the same ordered step list. Records validation is not touched; the check only inspects reading text, and any new record data file would need check_record_file, AnyRecord or a round-trip test. Properties are measured directly by fixture tests calling the check and by the replay test, not via stand-ins.

Job 20261113-143636-4thm had no candidate and no findings, so the whole previous scope is redone from base and all its deliverables are kept; the cited failure-class record and introspections are not edited.

Existing code: crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs and crates/athena-core/src/reading/replay.rs; the criteria extend check_code_survey helpers and check_reading_text rather than add near-duplicates.

The critic prompt under crates/athena-context/prompts/ has no headroom to spare, so the rules are enforced as a code check, not prompt edits; briefs reader.rs and briefs.rs change only if the reader brief must mention the new check.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-core/src/reading/surveys.rs defines a new pub check function built on changes_code_with_behavior_criterion and names_record_evidence, whose refusal error names which of (a) gate order and stop gate, (b) reused existing function, (c) record kind or round-trip deliverable, (d) direct check is missing; crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs wires it with one step! line directly after the check_code_survey step (check git diff).

Fixture tests in crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs and unit tests in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs show four otherwise complete readings, each omitting exactly one of (a)-(d), are refused with the missing part named, and one complete reading is accepted. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

Fixture tests show contradicting readings are refused: a new record deliverable with no accepted record kind and no round-trip test deliverable, and a direct check that is a skip switch (skip_probe, ATHENA_NO_PROBE) or a read of an internal helper; a negated mention is accepted; a routine criterion saying only fmt, clippy and test pass needs no direct-check clause. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

The change refuses more readings and the higher refusal rate is intended: expected 30% of newly refused readings, because the check now asks for new required labels that past readings never used. A replay test over recent accepted readings (crates/athena-core/src/reading/replay.rs) shows the newly refused share within 30% plus 5 points; if above, markers are not loosened and the measured share and newly refused job ids are reported. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

Every caller of check_reading_text is updated: `athena check-reading` still accepts its class 'feature' fixture reading, and a new CLI case shows a code reading with a short survey prints `refuse:` naming the new check. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
The prompt budgets test and the banned-word boundary test still pass and no file under crates/athena-context/prompts/ is edited. Run `cargo test -p athena-context`.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the change including the stated limit of skip-switch matching; athena.toml, defaults.toml, .github/workflows/ and records/ are unchanged (check git diff).
No unrelated behavior changes: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test pass on the final tree, as a recorded Athena check on the same tree.

out_of_scope: Editing records/ (including records/failure-classes/2026-10/20261028-055702-0t5w.json) or the cited introspections.
Editing any prompt file under crates/athena-context/prompts/, including the critic prompt.
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml or CI workflows.
Adding a pub SCHEMA_TAGS constant to athena-data.
Adding a planner repair round or other planning-pipeline changes.
departures: Multi-file refusal-rule change with a replay over records and CLI callers; costlier and riskier than the reference, and two earlier attempts never verified.
hard_reason: Adds a rule that can refuse readings (a reading check in the run pipeline) and changes the refusal rate.
